The correlation between these moves suggests less a pair of separate investment narratives than a single, powerful rotation.

articles.headline: Nvidia vs. AMD: The Next AI Battle Targets a $170 Billion Prize
articles.summary: Bank of America says the next AI war isn't about GPUs anymore. Nvidia and AMD are competing to define the future of a $170 billion server CPU market.
articles._summary: For nearly three years, investors judged the AI race by one metric: GPU performance. Bank of America thinks the next winner may depend on something far less discussed: server CPUs. The question isn’t which company builds the faster processor. It’s which metric customers decide matters most. Bank of America says Nvidia measures success by how quickly a single AI agent completes its work. “Nvidia introduced a new framework: max single-threaded performance at scale,” analyst Vivek Arya said.
articles._zh_headline: Nvidia vs. AMD：下一场人工智能之战的目标是 1700 亿美元
articles._zh_summary: 近三年来，投资者通过一个指标来评判人工智能竞赛：GPU 性能。美国银行认为下一个赢家可能取决于一些很少被讨论的东西：服务器 CPU。问题不在于哪家公司生产更快的处理器。这是客户决定的最重要的指标。美国银行表示，英伟达通过单个人工智能代理完成工作的速度来衡量成功。 “Nvidia 推出了一个新框架：大规模单线程性能最大化，”分析师 Vivek Arya 说道。

The S&P 500 gained 0.89% to close at 7,509.20. However, the July 22 Polymarket contract implied just a 15% probability that the index will open higher on Wednesday, with traders increasingly positioning for a weaker start.
articles._zh_headline: 股市：今天标普 500 指数会上涨还是下跌？
articles._zh_summary: 由于企业盈利强劲和半导体股票反弹提振股市，标准普尔 500 指数周二上涨。然而，Polymarket 交易员押注基准指数周三将开盘走低，因为油价上涨和新一轮通胀担忧给前景蒙上阴影。标准普尔 500 指数上涨 0.89%，收于 7,509.20 点。然而，7 月 22 日的 Polymarket 合约暗示该指数周三开盘走高的可能性仅为 15%，交易者越来越多地为弱势开局做准备。

articles.author: Radhika Anilkumar Nadig
articles.headline: Ross Gerber Renews Call For Disney Shake-Up After Stock Trails S&P 500 For 11 Years: 'Break Up The Mouse House Or Sell It'
articles.summary: Investor Ross Gerber renews Disney breakup call, says shareholders have "suffered too long" after 11 years of stock underperformance.
articles._summary: Gerber, who is also the CEO of Gerber Kawasaki , added that Disney’s individual businesses are worth more separately than together, saying shareholders have suffered too long. “Break up the mouse house or sell it,” Gerber added. Gerber has repeatedly criticized Disney’s strategy in recent days. Gerber also said Disney management had failed to unlock the value of its assets and argued shareholders were “sick of the dawdling” while executives continued to receive large compensation packages.
articles._zh_headline: 迪士尼股价连续 11 年落后于标准普尔 500 指数后，罗斯·格伯 (Ross Gerber) 再次呼吁进行重组：“要么拆散老鼠之家，要么卖掉它”
articles._zh_summary: 兼任格柏川崎公司首席执行官的格柏补充说，迪士尼各个业务的单独价值高于整体价值，并称股东遭受了太长时间的痛苦。 “拆掉老鼠屋或者卖掉它，”格伯补充道。格伯最近几天多次批评迪士尼的策略。格伯还表示，迪士尼管理层未能释放其资产的价值，并认为股东“厌倦了磨蹭”，而高管们却继续获得巨额薪酬。
